headline_seed: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya - NPR
draft_text:
Ukraine sank Russian corvette Merkury in Benghazi harbor Sunday using 7 domestically made naval drones launched from a mother ship — 1,500 miles from the front lines. CBS News and ABC News both confirm a Ka-27 helicopter was also destroyed.

And that's the mews.
